adapters.name: openrouter_free_brain
adapters.notes: Smoke test of the Brain path only, not commercial transfer quality. Requests strict JSON Schema output for the atoms contract.

adapters.name: openrouter_free_judge
adapters.notes: Independent vision judge, deliberately different from the Brain/Analyst model to reduce correlated errors. Free model availability and rate limits may change; every MUST visual atom is required.

adapters.name: openrouter_free_analyst
adapters.notes: Creative Radar manual analysis: sends a few video frames. Free models may be weak at timing details; switch the adapter name in settings to a paid vision model when you have a key.

adapters.name: hf_zerogpu_flux2_klein
adapters.price_hint: free; ZeroGPU quota controlled by Hugging Face
adapters.notes: api_name and argument order taken from the request diagnostics of run 39337237341 (prompt, input_images, mode_choice, seed, randomize_seed, width, height, num_inference_steps, guidance_scale, prompt_upsampling). prompt_upsampling is off so the Space does not rewrite the receipt-bound prompt; the old build enabled it for reference editing, compare on a second attempt if the result looks weak.

adapters.name: fal_flux2_pro
adapters.price_hint: about $0.03 per image on some channels (aggregator pages; verify on the fal pricing page)
adapters.notes: Confirm model_path and the reference parameter name on the fal model page before the first live run.
